name: Spring Airlines Co., Ltd.
summary: Spring Airlines Co., Ltd. operates as a Chinese airline primarily engaged in the transportation of both passengers and cargo, alongside offering various related aviation services. The company maintains a fleet of 102 A320 series aircraft, which it utilizes to serve approximately 210 domestic flight routes within China. Its network also extends to international and regional destinations across the rest of Asia, including Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan. Founded in 2005 and based in Shanghai, China, Spring Airlines operates as a subsidiary of Shanghai Spring International Travel Services Ltd.
